changelog: Two repairs from real use on Joshua's laptop. (1) THE FREEZE AFTER PICKING A BUILDING: picking a building used to make the program itself fetch the building's details, download and read the area's whole roads file, and work out the building's front — all before it would respond again, and all over again on every click, so on a slow connection the window locked up for seconds per click. Now the fetching and working-out happen in the background while the window stays alive (the usual download progress bar shows what's coming down), the answer appears when it lands, and the roads are read once and kept for the next picks instead of being re-read every time. Measured with a deliberately slow connection: picking Elizabeth Baptist Church cold took 7.6 seconds of frozen window before, 0.18 seconds now; repeat picks went from up-to-2-second freezes to under a tenth of a second. (2) THE OPENING LAYOUT: the editor opened with the two horizontal field rows pushed to the top and the buildings list squeezed to a sliver. The three split bars now open at their designed shares of the window — the list opens with about three quarters of its column and both field rows at their full height — at any window size, and dragging a bar still works as before. (3) Small extra fix found by the new tests: flipping a gas station to editable used to quietly deselect it (and print an error behind the scenes), greying out the 'Open in 3D view' button until the station was picked again; the station now stays selected.
